name: bible-study-tools
description: Interactive Bible study presentation system with synchronized video playback and teacher controls

scripts.build: npm run build:ts && vite build && vite build --config vite.api.config.mts
scripts.build:ts: tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json && tsc -p tsconfig.editor.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.features.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.shared.json --noEmit
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.editor.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.features.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.shared.json --noEmit
scripts.test:light: npm run check:syntax && npm run test:unit && npm run test:smoke:light && npm run test:e2e:priority && npm run test:e2e:a11y
scripts.test:heavy: npm run check:syntax && npm run test:unit && npm run test:smoke:heavy && npm run test:e2e:priority && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:e2e:a11y

author: Wes Huffman
